Nothing downloaded yet. Your saved videos and audio show up here.

How to use:
1. Run the TapSave backend and put its address above.
2. Pick quality (or Audio only) — used for every download.
3. Grant the overlay permission and start the floating button.
4. Videos: in TikTok/Instagram/Pinterest, copy the video link (or Share to TapSave), then tap the floating button.
5. WhatsApp statuses: open WhatsApp Status Saver once to allow file access. Then tap the floating button any time to pick a status from the grid — it saves just that one. (WhatsApp doesn’t tell apps which status is on screen, so you choose it.)

The button shows progress %, then a ✓, and saves to your Gallery (Movies/Pictures/TapSave) or Music/TapSave.

For content you own or have permission to download.
Tap any status below to save just that one. You can also tap the floating TapSave button while browsing statuses to get this picker anywhere. Nothing is saved automatically.
No statuses right now. Open a contact\'s status in WhatsApp, then come back — recently viewed photos and videos will appear here.
No WhatsApp status folder found yet. Make sure WhatsApp is installed and you\'ve opened at least one status, then reopen this screen.
To find WhatsApp statuses, TapSave needs permission to read files on your phone. On the next screen, turn on "Allow access to manage all files".
WhatsApp doesn\u2019t tell apps which status is on screen, so tap the one you want \u2014 it saves instantly.
